name: Icarus
note: The world's manifest (docs/order-plan.md, sprint D). `show` is MapShow, read by game/world/world_show.cpp: what the client draws, plays and hears here. A system opens only where its field is set. Copied to assets/world/<w>/world.json by tools/sync.sh.

air.note: aHeaven over the whole map, under no roof (SceneManager.cpp:885-895).

music.note: Ours: a horror ambient over the whole map (the user, 2026-10-06).

indoors.note: No open sky on any tile (MU draws it on its black clear, SceneManager.cpp:402).

boids.note: MODEL_DRAGON_ (CreateDragon, GOBoid.cpp:824), BodyLight (0.02, 0.05, 0.15) in Icarus (ZzzObject.cpp:487-493); it never calls.

sky_clouds.note: The cloud road and its lightning (game/world/sky_clouds.h).

haze.note: Ours, MU draws none there: wet cloud drifting past the eye, cool and barely there (the user, 2026-10-07: 'some screen dust effect but minimal, its cloud map').
